primary_source.citation: Barndorff-Nielsen, O.E., Kinnebrock, S. and Shephard, N. (2008). Measuring downside risk - realised semivariance.
primary_source.extraction_method: PDF content streams inflated; math glyph byte-codes decoded and cross-verified against contexts where mathematics fixes the meaning

glyph_resolution.0x00: minus, fixed by p-lim and Y_t - Y_{t-}
glyph_resolution.0x14: less-or-equal, fixed by sum over jump times s <= t and t_j <= t
glyph_resolution.0x15: greater-or-equal, fixed by t >= 0 in the Brownian semimartingale definition

artifact_hashes.hash_note: SHA-256 of LF-normalised bytes (CRLF->LF), project convention pre_reg_guard._sha256_lf. Truncated as stored by the existing pre-registration convention.

source_formula.identity_note: RS- + RS+ = RV exactly: the only overlapping point r=0 contributes r^2=0. Verified empirically at A4 over 2031 days, max abs error 0.000e+00.
source_formula.zero_return_treatment: counted in BOTH RS- and RS+, contributing exactly zero to each
source_formula.scaling_constant_note: None. Unlike bipower variation, realised semivariance carries no mu factor.

hypothesis.statement: In a structurally long-skewed BTC perpetual book, downside-dominated realized variance is disproportionately mechanical (liquidation cascades on the crowded side) and therefore a candidate for reversal, while upside-dominated variance marks leverage accumulating and rising fragility.
hypothesis.expected_sign: positive mean forward return when SJ is in its bottom trailing tercile; negative when in its top tercile
hypothesis.premise_source: Long-skewed positioning is already registered on this platform: decision_function_g2_funding_level.py states that perpetual funding is the price longs pay shorts.
hypothesis.null_hypothesis: The trailing tercile rank of SJ has no predictive relationship with forward BTC returns.
hypothesis.falsification: Wrong if low-SJ days are not followed by relative strength and high-SJ days not by relative weakness. Direction may not be revised after any outcome is observed.
hypothesis.role_note: Feature role. No edge claim is made or supported; no performance statistic has ever been computed for this candidate.
rejected_alternatives: momentum on SJ - defensible in an information-driven market; rejected because the long-skewed-book premise makes the mechanical reading the stronger prior and is evidenced on this platform
one-sided long-only - better motivated on the long leg but adds an exposure convention as a second free parameter
RS- level instead of SJ - rejected at A3 as a volatility-level measure structurally duplicating the registered vol families

function_spec.name: Realized Semivariance Asymmetry (contrarian)
function_spec.hash_note: NOT IMPLEMENTED. File and hash are assigned at A6 and only then does this become hash-pinned.

sampling.note: Source prescribes no sampling frequency; it uses all available tick times.

completeness.incomplete_day_behaviour: drop the day entirely; never compute partially

return_definition.note: Resolves U6b. BNKS says only 'trade or quote prices' and never states log price.

day_boundary_return.note: Surfaced at A4, absent from the A3 draft. BTC trades 24/7 so there is no session break; excluding the boundary return is a choice, not a necessity. Chosen so a day's value cannot be dominated by one cross-boundary move.

transformation.affine_note: SJ = 1 - 2*(RS_minus/RV). Signed-asymmetry and downside-share formulations are affine transforms, so a tercile gate on either induces the identical partition. Not a discretionary choice.

function_spec.entry_condition_long: SJ <= rolling 33rd percentile over RW=252 days (min_periods=126)
function_spec.entry_condition_short: SJ >= rolling 67th percentile over RW=252 days (min_periods=126)
function_spec.flat_condition: SJ strictly between the terciles, OR SJ NaN, OR either quantile NaN
function_spec.exit_rule: scheduled exit at entry_date + 7 calendar days; no early exit; signal re-evaluated daily but a new trade opens only when none is open
function_spec.trade_counting_definition: one entry-to-exit pair is one trade; at most one open trade at a time
function_spec.cost_convention_note: Registered label specification 57ce016e51a0. Gate 6B.5 established this as a deliberate Specification distinct from the engine turnover model. NOT reopened by this candidate.
